description: C++23 campaign foundation with strategic clocks, canonical strategic/tactical frame routing, immutable background Player17 saves and primary/backup load recovery. The opt-in SDL3/Vulkan native client displays a real 500-system campaign with responsive text/panels, mouse navigation, pause/speed controls, transactional Save/Load/Exit and a research workspace using canonical C++ costs and commands. Its runtime requires no Godot or .NET. Exports seal declared data, licensed UI fonts and reviewed dependencies. Production presentation, audio, colony/system screens, fleet interaction and graphical parity remain open. Diagnostic timings are not an FPS guarantee.
